In [[mathematics]], a '''centered dodecahedral number''' is a [[Centered number|centered]] [[figurate number]] that represents a [[dodecahedron]]. The centered dodecahedral number for a specific ''n'' is given by

:<math>(2n+1)\left(5n^2+5n+1\right)</math>

The first such numbers are: [[1]], [[33 (number)|33]], [[155 (number)|155]], 427, 909, 1661, 2743, 4215, 6137, 8569, … {{OEIS|id=A005904}}.

==Congruence Relations==
* <math>CDC(n) \equiv 1 \pmod{2}</math>
* <math>CDC(n) \equiv 1-n \pmod{3}</math>
* <math>CDC(n) \equiv 2n+1 \pmod{3,5,6,10}</math>
